branding.title: Branding
branding.tip: Name, description and logo appear in the tab title, the header, the installed app (PWA) and search engines. Only the site itself is indexed, never the songs.
branding.name: Site name

discord.tip: Create an Application at discord.com/developers/applications: its name is what appears after “Listening to”. Users just run one command (a script served by this server, no exe to download).
discord.agentUrlHint: Users run the agent with the script at /agent.ps1 (Windows) or /agent.sh (macOS / Linux). Set this only to also offer exe builds (e.g. GitHub Releases).

logs.title: System logs
logs.tip: The server's latest 3,000 log lines, refreshed every 3 seconds. Passwords and tokens are masked.

limits.title: Suggestions and downloads
limits.autoplayTarget: Autoplay songs kept in the queue
limits.autoplayTargetHint: When the queue runs low it is topped up to this many ({min}–{max}, default 10).
limits.autoplayDownloads: New songs downloaded per autoplay top-up
limits.autoplayDownloadsHint: "Free" autoplay mode downloads songs you don't have yet ({min}–{max}, 0 = none, default 6).
limits.autoDlPerRunHint: Every 6 hours, within each user's storage limit ({min}–{max}, default 10).
limits.playlistMax: Max songs per playlist / album link
limits.playlistMaxHint: The rest of a longer playlist is skipped ({min}–{max}, default 200).

tags.title: Genres and languages
tags.tip: Genres come from Last.fm / Deezer through a queue (about one song per second) so suggestions don't mix styles. When a service rate-limits, it pauses and resumes on its own.
tags.providerDeezer: Source: Deezer (add LASTFM_API_KEY for better tags)
tags.confirm: Scan genres and languages again for all {n} songs? Suggestions keep working meanwhile.
